lead_post.text:
https://t.co/y6Jc8DwQ05 says it plans to procure 3 million robots, 1 million autonomous vehicles and 100,000 drones over five years.

The bigger opportunity may be everything required to keep that fleet running.

https://t.co/y6Jc8DwQ05 has outlined a five-year logistics automation plan involving:

- 3 million robots
- 1 million autonomous vehicles
- 100,000 delivery drones

These are company targets, not completed deployments.

But the scale is still important.

If even part of that plan becomes real, it would create one of the world’s largest markets for the businesses around autonomous logistics.

Millions of machines do not run on hardware alone.

They need:

- Batteries, charging and energy-management systems
- Maintenance depots and spare-parts networks
- Warehouse integration and facility redesign
- Fleet-management, mapping and routing software
- Connectivity, cybersecurity and safety systems
- Remote operations and exception-handling teams
- Training, insurance, leasing and financing
- Last-mile infrastructure and package-handoff systems

The headline is robots.

The economic story is a new logistics infrastructure industry being built around them.

Reality check: https://t.co/y6Jc8DwQ05’s figures are procurement targets and company plans.

They should not be treated as current deployment totals.

The key questions are whether the machines can operate reliably in real warehouses, cities and delivery routes—and whether maintenance, energy, labor savings and operational complexity produce a clear return on investment.

What to watch: the first hard operating metrics:
robot uptime, delivery cost per parcel, maintenance cost, labor productivity and the number of facilities running autonomous fleets every day.

lead_post.translation_zh:
JD.com 表示，计划在五年内采购 300 万台机器人、100 万辆自动驾驶车辆和 100,000 架无人机。

更大的机会可能在于维持这支车队运转所需的一切。

JD.com 概述了一项为期五年的物流自动化计划，包括：

- 300 万台机器人
- 100 万辆自动驾驶车辆
- 100,000 架配送无人机

这些是公司目标，不是已完成的部署。

但其规模仍然重要。

如果该计划哪怕只有一部分成为现实，也将为自动化物流周边企业创造全球最大的市场之一。

数百万台机器并不只靠硬件运行。

它们需要：

- 电池、充电和能源管理系统
- 维护站点和备件网络
- 仓库集成和设施重新设计
- 车队管理、地图和路线规划软件
- 连接性、网络安全和安全系统
- 远程运营和异常处理团队
- 培训、保险、租赁和融资
- 最后一公里基础设施和包裹交接系统

头条是机器人。

经济层面的故事，是一个围绕它们建立起来的新物流基础设施行业。

现实核查：JD.com 的数字是采购目标和公司计划。

不应将其视为当前部署总量。

关键问题在于，这些机器能否在真实仓库、城市和配送路线中可靠运行，以及维护、能源、劳动力节省和运营复杂性是否能产生明确的投资回报。

值得关注的是第一批硬性运营指标：
机器人正常运行时间、每件包裹配送成本、维护成本、劳动生产率，以及每天运行自动化车队的设施数量。

featured_items.title: Trust, safety and authenticity concerns
featured_items.display_title: 相关讨论涉及信任、安全、真假或隐私相关担忧。
featured_items.original_text:
China’s humanoid race is moving from demos to factory floors.

Spirit AI says dozens of its Moz1 robots are already working at CATL and https://t.co/qaYwIAuir1.

Its models hit ~90% success on simple structured tasks, while ~1,000 contractors collect real-world training data across China.

Its founder expects a GPT-3 moment for robot intelligence by mid-2027.

The bigger race may not be who builds the best robot body, but who collects enough physical-world data to make robots actually useful.
featured_items.translation_zh:
中国的人形机器人竞赛正从演示走向工厂车间。

Spirit AI 表示，数十台 Moz1 机器人已经在 CATL 和 JD.com 工作

其模型在简单结构化任务上的成功率达到约 90%，同时约 1,000 名承包商在中国各地收集真实世界训练数据。

其创始人预计，到 2027 年年中，机器人智能将迎来 GPT-3 时刻。

更大的竞赛可能不是谁能制造出最好的机器人身体，而是谁能收集到足够的物理世界数据，让机器人真正有用。
